_meta.description: Per-Lagna nuance notes for high-Lagna-dependent yogas. Each yoga × 12 Lagnas matrix. Generated by per-Lagna research agent (2026-05-30). Loaded at module init via _enrich_with_sidecars(); merged into TranslationRecord.lagna_specific_notes.
_meta.cell_structure: lagna_sign (1..12) -> doctrine-faithful modifier note explaining how this yoga reads differently for that Lagna because of functional role shifts (Yogakaraka / Maraka / Lagna lord / Badhakesh / functional benefic-malefic).
_meta.authority: BPHS Ch.34 (Yogakaraka derivation), Ch.36 (Yoga prakaraṇa); Phaladeepika Ch.15 (Badhakesh per modality); per-yoga citations preserved inline.

Mangal Dosha::kinship.1: Aries: Mars is Lagna lord + 8L (own sign Scorpio). As Lagna lord, Mars in 1/4/7/8 actually empowers vitality and willpower — dosha intensity is MUTED. The 7H placement still strains marriage but reads as 'intense partner' rather than destructive; classical exemption applies when Mars is own-sign.
Mangal Dosha::kinship.2: Taurus: Mars is 7L + 12L — both maraka/dusthana lord. Mangal Dosha here is AMPLIFIED: Mars carries marriage-killing potential intrinsically, so adverse placements (especially 7H/8H) compound the affliction. Marital delay and conflict reads as doctrinally severe.
Mangal Dosha::kinship.3: Gemini: Mars is 6L + 11L — functional malefic but gains-giving. Dosha is moderate; 6L energy means marital friction often surfaces as litigation, in-law conflict, or health stress on spouse rather than separation per se.
Mangal Dosha::kinship.4: Cancer: Mars is YOGAKARAKA (5L + 10L). Dosha intensity is significantly REDUCED — Mars carries career-and-progeny blessing. 7H Mars still creates spouse-power-struggle but the dosha gets transmuted into a 'strong-willed productive partner' reading; remedies often unnecessary.
Mangal Dosha::kinship.5: Leo: Mars is YOGAKARAKA (4L + 9L) — dharma + home lord. Strongest mitigation of the seven: Mars in dosha houses brings property, vehicle, and father's blessing dimensions even while stressing marriage. Classical cancellation widely accepted for Leo Lagna.
Mangal Dosha::kinship.6: Virgo: Mars is 3L + 8L. Both houses are 'growth-through-difficulty' sectors. Dosha reads true — marriage friction is genuine, often manifesting as accidents, surgery, or sudden upheaval involving the spouse (8L signature).
Mangal Dosha::kinship.7: Libra: Mars is 2L + 7L — Maraka in both senses (2L = primary maraka; 7L = secondary). Dosha is DOUBLY AMPLIFIED: Mars is the marriage-significator-by-lordship AND life-threatening-significator. Most severe Mangal reading among all 12 Lagnas; classical mandates strict remedy.
Mangal Dosha::kinship.8: Scorpio: Mars is Lagna lord + 6L. Lagna-lord status mitigates personal harm, but 6L overlay means marital strife often takes adversarial/legal form. Dosha is real but reads as 'conflict-prone marriage that survives' rather than dissolution.
Mangal Dosha::kinship.9: Sagittarius: Mars is 5L + 12L. Mixed: 5L gives progeny blessing (a Mangal-dosha softener via children), but 12L brings bed-pleasure-loss and foreign-separation overtones. Net dosha is moderate, with progeny acting as the marital glue.
Mangal Dosha::kinship.10: Capricorn: Mars is exalted-by-sign — 4L + 11L. Mars exalts IN Capricorn so any placement carries dignity. Dosha is materially MUTED; 4H/7H Mars often reads as power-couple dynamic rather than affliction. Functional benefic for this Lagna.
Mangal Dosha::kinship.11: Aquarius: Mars is 3L + 10L. Strong career signature reduces marital-focus severity; dosha reads as 'career-obsessed partner' or workaholism-driven friction rather than violence/separation. Moderate intensity.
Mangal Dosha::kinship.12: Pisces: Mars is 2L + 9L — Dhana lord and Dharma lord, both rare benefic-by-lordship roles. Dosha is SIGNIFICANTLY MUTED for Pisces Lagna; Mars carries family-wealth and father-blessing dimensions. 7H Mars reads as 'spouse from dharmic background' more than affliction.

bhava_10_planet_Saturn::career_wealth.1: Aries: Saturn is 10L + 11L — owns 10H itself but is functional malefic for fire Lagna. Saturn in 10H gives slow, delayed but ultimately serious career; harsh early years, authority recognition only after Saturn maturity (~36). Reads as 'earned hard' not 'granted.'
bhava_10_planet_Saturn::career_wealth.2: Taurus: YOGAKARAKA — Saturn rules 9L+10L (Dharma+Karma). Strongest possible 10H placement; classical Raja Yoga signature. Career success is structural, long-lasting, often in government, law, engineering, or institutional roles.
bhava_10_planet_Saturn::career_wealth.3: Gemini: Saturn is 8L + 9L. 8L overlay makes 10H Saturn give transformation-through-career, often disruptive shifts and karmic-style work (research, occult, insurance). Career has hidden/unconventional dimension; success comes through upheaval.
bhava_10_planet_Saturn::career_wealth.4: Cancer: Saturn is 7L + 8L — functional malefic of high order. 10H Saturn brings career struggle, prolonged delay, public reputation damage risk; this is the WORST Lagna for this placement. Often signifies forced career changes via partnership-collapse or unexpected events.
bhava_10_planet_Saturn::career_wealth.5: Leo: Saturn is 6L + 7L — functional malefic but service/partnership-oriented. 10H Saturn gives career through service, employment, or partnership (not entrepreneurship); ego friction with authority is chronic. Status comes late and through subordinate-style routes.
bhava_10_planet_Saturn::career_wealth.6: Virgo: Saturn is 5L + 6L. Mixed — 5L gives intellectual/creative career, 6L gives service-disputes. 10H Saturn reads as 'intellectually demanding service career'; suits academia, law, healthcare administration. Steady but unspectacular.
bhava_10_planet_Saturn::career_wealth.7: Libra: YOGAKARAKA — Saturn rules 4L+5L (Sukha+Putra). Strongest 10H reading after Taurus; career brings property, comfort, and creative-progeny dimensions. Classical Raja Yoga; success is broad-based, not just professional.
bhava_10_planet_Saturn::career_wealth.8: Scorpio: Saturn is 3L + 4L. 10H Saturn gives writing/communication-based career (3L) with eventual property/peace (4L). Effort-heavy but rewards with security; reads as 'self-made' trajectory often in publishing, media, or real estate.
bhava_10_planet_Saturn::career_wealth.9: Sagittarius: Saturn is 2L + 3L. 10H Saturn brings wealth-through-effort and communication-based work. Reads moderately well — career is verbal/intellectual, accumulates wealth slowly. No yogakaraka boost but no severe malefic-overlay either.
bhava_10_planet_Saturn::career_wealth.10: Capricorn: Saturn is Lagna lord + 2L. 10H Saturn = own-sign placement (Saturn in Capricorn in 10H); SVA-rashi, highly powerful. Career is identity-defining, long-lasting, authoritative. Among the strongest classical 10H readings; Saturn carries self-as-career signature.
bhava_10_planet_Saturn::career_wealth.11: Aquarius: Saturn is Lagna lord + 12L. Own-sign 10H (Saturn in Aquarius); strong but with 12L overlay meaning career often abroad, in research/seclusion, or with significant losses/sacrifices. Reads as visionary-but-isolated career path.
bhava_10_planet_Saturn::career_wealth.12: Pisces: Saturn is 11L + 12L — both malefic-by-lordship for Pisces. 10H Saturn gives career via foreign lands or institutional/charitable work; gains come but accompanied by losses, expenses, or expatriation. Reads as 'career that takes you away from home.'

Gajakesari::career_wealth.1: Aries: Jupiter is 9L + 12L. 9L dignity makes Gajakesari STRONG — dharma and fortune blessing dominant. 12L overlay adds spiritual/foreign dimension; reads as wisdom-with-renunciation tendency.
Gajakesari::career_wealth.2: Taurus: Jupiter is 8L + 11L — functional malefic for Taurus. Gajakesari is MUTED; despite the Moon-Jupiter Kendra geometry, Jupiter's malefic lordship dilutes the blessing. Reads as 'intellectual depth with hidden obstacles.'
Gajakesari::career_wealth.3: Gemini: Jupiter is 7L + 10L — Maraka (7L) but also Karma lord. Gajakesari reads as career-and-marriage success but with 7L-maraka edge; wisdom comes through public/spousal interface.
Gajakesari::career_wealth.4: Cancer: Jupiter is 6L + 9L. 9L gives dharma blessing, 6L adds service/health dimension. Gajakesari is GENUINELY STRONG — Jupiter in Cancer gets exalted, amplifying family, dharma, and healing reputation.
Gajakesari::career_wealth.5: Leo: Jupiter is 5L + 8L. 5L gives progeny/intellect blessing, 8L adds occult/research depth. Gajakesari reads as wisdom-through-transformation; suits philosophers, researchers, esoteric teachers.
Gajakesari::career_wealth.6: Virgo: Jupiter is 4L + 7L — both Kendra lords but functional malefic for Mercurial Lagna (Kendradhipati Dosha). Gajakesari is structurally MUTED — Jupiter carries Kendra-malefic burden.
Gajakesari::career_wealth.7: Libra: Jupiter is 3L + 6L — functional malefic. Gajakesari is WEAK for Libra Lagna; Jupiter's 6L overlay makes wisdom come through conflict, litigation, or service-struggle. Among the weakest Lagnas for this yoga.
Gajakesari::career_wealth.8: Scorpio: Jupiter is 2L + 5L — Dhana lord and Putra lord, both highly auspicious. Gajakesari is VERY STRONG; wealth + progeny + intellect cluster strongly. Classical example of Lagna where Gajakesari delivers full effect.
Gajakesari::career_wealth.9: Sagittarius: Jupiter is Lagna lord + 4L. Strongest possible reading — Jupiter rules the self and the home/peace. Gajakesari reads as core-identity-as-wisdom; teacher/sage archetype most natural here.
Gajakesari::career_wealth.10: Capricorn: Jupiter is 3L + 12L — functional malefic for Capricorn. Gajakesari is MUTED; reads as wisdom-via-loss or spiritual-renunciation rather than worldly blessing.
Gajakesari::career_wealth.11: Aquarius: Jupiter is 2L + 11L. Gains-and-wealth lord conjunction with Moon Kendra; Gajakesari reads as financial-wisdom and large social-network blessing. Strong materially.
Gajakesari::career_wealth.12: Pisces: Jupiter is Lagna lord + 10L. Among the strongest readings — Jupiter rules self and career. Gajakesari delivers public-wisdom-recognition; classical guru-figure signature.

Lakshmi::career_wealth.1: Aries: 9L = Jupiter (in Sagittarius). Jupiter dignified + Venus/Jupiter in Kendra forms STRONG Lakshmi — natural dharma-fortune signature for fire Lagna. Reads as wealth-via-wisdom-and-teaching.
Lakshmi::career_wealth.2: Taurus: 9L = Saturn — and Saturn is YOGAKARAKA for Taurus. Lakshmi here is EXTRAORDINARY; the 9L is the most beneficial planet for this Lagna. Classical wealth-through-institutional-power signature.
Lakshmi::career_wealth.3: Gemini: 9L = Saturn (Aquarius). Saturn is 8L+9L for Gemini; mixed but 9L dignity gives Lakshmi structural strength. Reads as wealth-through-research/occult/long-effort rather than easy fortune.
Lakshmi::career_wealth.4: Cancer: 9L = Jupiter (Pisces). Lakshmi reads as VERY STRONG — Jupiter dignified for water Lagna with exaltation potential. Wealth through dharma, teaching, family-tradition.
Lakshmi::career_wealth.5: Leo: 9L = Mars (Aries). Mars is YOGAKARAKA for Leo — Lakshmi is EXCEPTIONAL. Wealth through bold action, leadership, property/land; one of the strongest classical Lakshmi readings.
Lakshmi::career_wealth.6: Virgo: 9L = Venus (Taurus). Venus is also 9L AND already in the yoga as benefic-in-Kendra; structurally tight Lakshmi. Wealth-through-luxury-arts-partnerships; strong for creative-commerce careers.
Lakshmi::career_wealth.7: Libra: 9L = Mercury (Gemini). Mercury 9L + Venus (Lagna lord) Kendra gives Lakshmi via commerce/communication. Wealth-through-trade-and-negotiation; strong commercial signature.
Lakshmi::career_wealth.8: Scorpio: 9L = Moon (Cancer). Moon as 9L is rare-fortune-marker for Scorpio; Lakshmi reads as wealth-through-mother/public/emotional-intelligence. Strong but emotionally-tinged fortune.
Lakshmi::career_wealth.9: Sagittarius: 9L = Sun (Leo). Sun as 9L dignified for fire Lagna gives Lakshmi via authority, government, father's blessing. Royal-fortune signature.
Lakshmi::career_wealth.10: Capricorn: 9L = Mercury (Virgo). Mercury 9L + Venus YOGAKARAKA in Kendra delivers Lakshmi as commerce-meets-yogakaraka. Strong wealth structure; trading, analysis, financial intermediation.
Lakshmi::career_wealth.11: Aquarius: 9L = Venus (Libra). Venus is BOTH 9L AND the Kendra benefic of the yoga — Lakshmi is structurally tight, redundancy amplifies. Wealth via art, luxury, partnerships.
Lakshmi::career_wealth.12: Pisces: 9L = Mars (Scorpio). Mars 9L for Pisces is dignified-by-rulership; Lakshmi reads as wealth-via-energetic-action and property; strong but action-driven rather than gracefully-flowing fortune.

Vipareeta Raja::career_wealth.1: Aries: 6L=Mercury, 8L=Mars (Lagna lord), 12L=Jupiter (9L). Vipareeta is COMPLEX — 8L is your own Lagna lord and 12L is your dharma lord. Reads as 'transformation that costs you identity or dharma' — gains real but spiritually expensive.
Vipareeta Raja::career_wealth.2: Taurus: 6L=Venus (Lagna lord), 8L=Jupiter, 12L=Mars. Vipareeta here means Lagna-lord Venus must afflict itself in dusthana — unusual. Often gains-through-loss in 8H Jupiter or 12H Mars configurations; spiritual-financial tradeoff.
Vipareeta Raja::career_wealth.3: Gemini: 6L=Mars, 8L=Saturn, 12L=Moon. Standard Vipareeta reads cleanly — all three lords are functional malefics for Gemini except Moon. Strong material-gain-through-difficulty signature.
Vipareeta Raja::career_wealth.4: Cancer: 6L=Jupiter, 8L=Saturn, 12L=Mercury. CRITICAL — Jupiter (natural benefic + 9L from default) is 6L here. Vipareeta involving Jupiter is muted because hurting Jupiter's significations costs dharma. 'Gains-through-spiritual-compromise.'
Vipareeta Raja::career_wealth.5: Leo: 6L=Saturn, 8L=Jupiter, 12L=Moon. Jupiter as 8L for Leo means 8H Jupiter Vipareeta brings research/occult gains but at cost of progeny (Jupiter natural-significator-of-children). Mixed reading.
Vipareeta Raja::career_wealth.6: Virgo: 6L=Saturn, 8L=Mars, 12L=Sun. Vipareeta strong — all three lords are functional malefics. Sun-12L in 12H gives clean classical reading of foreign-residence gains; Mars-8L in 8H gives surgery/inheritance gains.
Vipareeta Raja::career_wealth.7: Libra: 6L=Jupiter, 8L=Venus (Lagna lord), 12L=Mercury. Two complications — Jupiter is natural benefic AND Venus is Lagna lord. Vipareeta is doctrinally MUTED; using these placements as 'raja yoga' risks self-harm and dharma-cost.
Vipareeta Raja::career_wealth.8: Scorpio: 6L=Mars (Lagna lord), 8L=Venus, 12L=Venus. Mars is Lagna lord — using 6H Mars as Vipareeta means hurting your own vitality. Reads as gains-at-cost-of-health-or-self.
Vipareeta Raja::career_wealth.9: Sagittarius: 6L=Venus, 8L=Moon, 12L=Mercury. Clean Vipareeta — none of the three are dignified-by-yoga-context. 8H Moon Vipareeta is famous for occult/research wealth.
Vipareeta Raja::career_wealth.10: Capricorn: 6L=Mercury, 8L=Sun, 12L=Jupiter. Jupiter as 12L for Capricorn — Vipareeta with Jupiter in 12H gives foreign-spiritual gains. Sun-8L gives inheritance via authority. Strong reading.
Vipareeta Raja::career_wealth.11: Aquarius: 6L=Moon, 8L=Mercury, 12L=Saturn (Lagna lord). Saturn-12L is also Lagna-lord for Aquarius — using Saturn in 12H as Vipareeta hurts self-significations. Gains often at cost of personal isolation.
Vipareeta Raja::career_wealth.12: Pisces: 6L=Sun, 8L=Venus, 12L=Saturn. Saturn-12L for Pisces in 12H gives clean foreign-and-research gains. Sun-6L in 6H is classical 'victorious over enemies' Vipareeta. Strong overall structure.

Pitra_Dosha::dharma.1: Aries: Sun is 5L — Trikona lord, highly auspicious. Pitra Dosha here STRONGLY HARMS because the affliction hits both ancestral karma AND progeny/intellect significations. Severe reading; remedies emphasised.
Pitra_Dosha::dharma.2: Taurus: Sun is 4L — Kendra lord but functional malefic for Taurus. Pitra Dosha reads as ancestral-karma manifesting in home/mother/emotional unrest; moderate severity.
Pitra_Dosha::dharma.3: Gemini: Sun is 3L — neutral-to-mild-malefic. Pitra Dosha is MODERATE; affliction manifests in sibling-conflict or short-journey misfortune as karma-from-ancestors.
Pitra_Dosha::dharma.4: Cancer: Sun is 2L — Maraka. Pitra Dosha here is SEVERE because Sun-Maraka affliction by Rahu compounds family-wealth and longevity stress. Classical reading flags family-line-extinction risk.
Pitra_Dosha::dharma.5: Leo: Sun is LAGNA LORD. Pitra Dosha is the MOST SEVERE possible — afflicting the Lagna lord means ancestral karma directly attacks self, vitality, identity. Mandates immediate remedy; classical Tarpana strongly recommended.
Pitra_Dosha::dharma.6: Virgo: Sun is 12L. Pitra Dosha reads as ancestral karma causing foreign-residence, isolation, hospitalisation, or expenses-from-ancestral-disputes. Severe in 12H manifestation; moderate elsewhere.
Pitra_Dosha::dharma.7: Libra: Sun is 11L. Pitra Dosha mutes income/network potential; ancestral karma manifests as social-circle obstruction or elder-friend losses. Mild-to-moderate severity.
Pitra_Dosha::dharma.8: Scorpio: Sun is 10L. Pitra Dosha damages career reputation and father's professional standing transferring as obstruction. SEVERE for career; classical reading flags public-disgrace risk.
Pitra_Dosha::dharma.9: Sagittarius: Sun is 9L — dharma/father lord exactly. Pitra Dosha here is STRUCTURALLY THE PRIMARY READING because 9L IS the father-significator-by-lordship. Severe; most doctrinally pure Pitra Dosha case after Leo Lagna.
Pitra_Dosha::dharma.10: Capricorn: Sun is 8L. Pitra Dosha manifests as longevity/transformation crises traced to ancestral karma; reads as hidden-family-curse or inheritance-disputes. Severe in 8H placements.
Pitra_Dosha::dharma.11: Aquarius: Sun is 7L — Maraka and partnership lord. Pitra Dosha brings marital obstruction or spouse-related ancestral conflict; severe for marriage timing.
Pitra_Dosha::dharma.12: Pisces: Sun is 6L — functional malefic. Pitra Dosha here paradoxically reads MILD-TO-MODERATE because 6L afflictions sometimes resolve via Vipareeta-like clearance through health-struggle or service.
